import sys, json
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd


def main():
    df = pd.read_csv(sys.argv[1])
    facts = []

    def add(entity, metric, period, value, formula):
        if value is None or (isinstance(value, float) and not np.isfinite(value)):
            return
        if pd.isna(value):
            return
        facts.append({
            "entity": str(entity),
            "metric": metric,
            "period": period,
            "value": round(float(value), 2),
            "formula": formula,
        })

    num_cols = ["Revenue_TW", "Revenue_LW", "Revenue_LY", "Units_TW", "Units_LW",
                "Orders_TW", "Orders_LW", "WoW_Pct", "YoY_Pct", "Share_Pct", "Rank"]
    for c in num_cols:
        if c in df.columns:
            df[c] = pd.to_numeric(df[c], errors="coerce")

    # ---- Totals ----
    tw = df["Revenue_TW"].sum(skipna=True)
    lw = df["Revenue_LW"].sum(skipna=True)
    ly = df["Revenue_LY"].sum(skipna=True)
    add("TOTAL", "revenue", "TW", tw, "sum(Revenue_TW)")
    add("TOTAL", "revenue", "LW", lw, "sum(Revenue_LW)")
    if ly > 0:
        add("TOTAL", "revenue", "LY", ly, "sum(Revenue_LY)")
    if lw > 0:
        add("TOTAL", "revenue", "WoW", round((tw - lw) / lw * 100, 1),
            "(sum(Revenue_TW) - sum(Revenue_LW)) / sum(Revenue_LW) * 100")
    if ly > 0:
        add("TOTAL", "revenue", "YoY", round((tw - ly) / ly * 100, 1),
            "(sum(Revenue_TW) - sum(Revenue_LY)) / sum(Revenue_LY) * 100")

    u_tw = df["Units_TW"].sum(skipna=True)
    u_lw = df["Units_LW"].sum(skipna=True)
    add("TOTAL", "units", "TW", u_tw, "sum(Units_TW)")
    if u_lw > 0:
        add("TOTAL", "units", "WoW", round((u_tw - u_lw) / u_lw * 100, 1),
            "(sum(Units_TW) - sum(Units_LW)) / sum(Units_LW) * 100")

    o_tw = df["Orders_TW"].sum(skipna=True)
    o_lw = df["Orders_LW"].sum(skipna=True)
    add("TOTAL", "orders", "TW", o_tw, "sum(Orders_TW)")
    if o_lw > 0:
        add("TOTAL", "orders", "WoW", round((o_tw - o_lw) / o_lw * 100, 1),
            "(sum(Orders_TW) - sum(Orders_LW)) / sum(Orders_LW) * 100")

    # ---- Top entities by revenue this week ----
    top = df.dropna(subset=["Revenue_TW"]).sort_values("Revenue_TW", ascending=False)
    for _, r in top.head(3).iterrows():
        add(r["Entity"], "revenue", "TW", r["Revenue_TW"], "Revenue_TW for the entity")
        share = r["Share_Pct"] if pd.notna(r.get("Share_Pct")) else (
            r["Revenue_TW"] / tw * 100 if tw else np.nan)
        add(r["Entity"], "share", "TW", round(float(share), 1),
            "Revenue_TW / sum(Revenue_TW) * 100")
        if pd.notna(r.get("Rank")):
            add(r["Entity"], "rank", "TW", r["Rank"], "rank by Revenue_TW (1 is highest)")

    # Top 3 combined share
    if tw > 0 and len(top) >= 3:
        add("TOTAL", "share", "TW", round(top.head(3)["Revenue_TW"].sum() / tw * 100, 1),
            "sum(top 3 Revenue_TW) / sum(Revenue_TW) * 100")

    # ---- WoW movers ----
    d = df.dropna(subset=["Revenue_TW", "Revenue_LW"]).copy()
    if not d.empty:
        d["abs_wow"] = d["Revenue_TW"] - d["Revenue_LW"]
        up = d.sort_values("abs_wow", ascending=False).head(2)
        for _, r in up.iterrows():
            if r["abs_wow"] > 0:
                add(r["Entity"], "revenue", "WoW", round(r["abs_wow"], 2),
                    "Revenue_TW - Revenue_LW")
        dn = d.sort_values("abs_wow").head(2)
        for _, r in dn.iterrows():
            if r["abs_wow"] < 0:
                add(r["Entity"], "revenue", "WoW", round(r["abs_wow"], 2),
                    "Revenue_TW - Revenue_LW")

    p = df.dropna(subset=["WoW_Pct"])
    if not p.empty:
        r = p.loc[p["WoW_Pct"].idxmax()]
        add(r["Entity"], "revenue", "WoW", round(r["WoW_Pct"], 1),
            "(Revenue_TW - Revenue_LW) / Revenue_LW * 100")
        r = p.loc[p["WoW_Pct"].idxmin()]
        add(r["Entity"], "revenue", "WoW", round(r["WoW_Pct"], 1),
            "(Revenue_TW - Revenue_LW) / Revenue_LW * 100")

    # ---- YoY movers ----
    y = df.dropna(subset=["Revenue_TW", "Revenue_LY"]).copy()
    if not y.empty:
        y["abs_yoy"] = y["Revenue_TW"] - y["Revenue_LY"]
        r = y.loc[y["abs_yoy"].idxmax()]
        add(r["Entity"], "revenue", "YoY", round(r["abs_yoy"], 2),
            "Revenue_TW - Revenue_LY")
        r = y.loc[y["abs_yoy"].idxmin()]
        add(r["Entity"], "revenue", "YoY", round(r["abs_yoy"], 2),
            "Revenue_TW - Revenue_LY")

    py = df.dropna(subset=["YoY_Pct"])
    if not py.empty:
        r = py.loc[py["YoY_Pct"].idxmax()]
        add(r["Entity"], "revenue", "YoY", round(r["YoY_Pct"], 1),
            "(Revenue_TW - Revenue_LY) / Revenue_LY * 100")
        r = py.loc[py["YoY_Pct"].idxmin()]
        add(r["Entity"], "revenue", "YoY", round(r["YoY_Pct"], 1),
            "(Revenue_TW - Revenue_LY) / Revenue_LY * 100")

    # ---- Units / orders leaders ----
    uu = df.dropna(subset=["Units_TW"])
    if not uu.empty:
        r = uu.loc[uu["Units_TW"].idxmax()]
        add(r["Entity"], "units", "TW", r["Units_TW"], "max(Units_TW)")
    oo = df.dropna(subset=["Orders_TW"])
    if not oo.empty:
        r = oo.loc[oo["Orders_TW"].idxmax()]
        add(r["Entity"], "orders", "TW", r["Orders_TW"], "max(Orders_TW)")

    # de-duplicate and cap
    seen = set()
    out = []
    for f in facts:
        k = (f["entity"], f["metric"], f["period"], f["value"])
        if k in seen:
            continue
        seen.add(k)
        out.append(f)

    print(json.dumps(out[:25]))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
